chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Misma'a, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Arafaat, all of it is a Pausing Station, and the most superior of the Pausing Station is at the base of the mountain.

key_terms.سَفْحُ الْجَبَلِ: Safḥ al-Jabal, the base or foot of the mountain, specifically referring to Jabal al-Rahmah.
key_terms.عَرَفَاتٌ: Arafaat, the sacred plain and primary station of Hajj.
key_terms.مَوْقِفٌ: Mawqif, the station or place of standing required during Hajj.

ai.seo_question: What is the definition and superior location of the Mawqif at Arafaat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the jurisprudential scope of the Hajj station (Mawqif) at Arafaat, establishing that the entire plain constitutes a valid place of standing while highlighting the base of Jabal al-Rahmah as the most superior location. This distinction reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on following the Prophet's and Imams' specific practices, reinforcing the validity of the broader area while encouraging adherence to the preferred sunnah. The ruling underscores the flexibility in Hajj rituals while maintaining the sanctity of the primary site of divine encounter.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Misma’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Arafaat, all of it is a Pausing Station, and the most superior of the Pausing Station is at the base of the mountain’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from Misma’ who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
All of ‘Arafat is al-Mawqaf (the station) and the best of it is the foot of the hill.’”
